ex.en: Due to the worsening weather, the departure was delayed.
ex.zh: 由於天氣變差，出發延遲了。

ex.en: We postponed our departure because of the storm.
ex.zh: 我們因為暴風雨延後出發。

ex.en: He has postponed his departure until tomorrow.
ex.zh: 他把出發的時間延到明天了。

ex.en: The weather was bad so the plane was delayed.
ex.zh: 由於天氣惡劣，飛機延誤了。

ex.en: The train was delayed because of heavy snowfall.
ex.zh: 火車因為大雪而延誤了。

ex.en: An accident delayed us for half an hour.
ex.zh: 一場意外耽誤了我們半小時。

ex.en: The schedule is only slightly affected by this delay.
ex.zh: 這次延誤對時程的影響很小。

ex.en: I was late as a result of the train delay.
ex.zh: 由於火車延誤，我遲到了。

ex.en: When you safely arrive at your destination, don't forget to call me.
ex.zh: 你安全到達目的地以後，別忘記打個電話告訴我。

ex.en: They made straight for their destination.
ex.zh: 他們直奔目的地。

ex.en: The ship was on the point of arriving at her destination.
ex.zh: 這艘船就快抵達目的地了。

ex.en: You have to give three months' rent as a deposit.
ex.zh: 你必須付三個月的房租作為押金。

ex.en: The hotel asked for a deposit of 2,000 dollars.
ex.zh: 飯店要求付 2,000 元的押金。

ex.en: I made a deposit of $1,000 at the bank.
ex.zh: 我在銀行存了 1,000 美元。

ex.en: You can make a deposit at any ATM.
ex.zh: 你可以在任何一台提款機存款。

ex.en: He deposited the prize money in the bank.
ex.zh: 他把獎金存進銀行了。

ex.en: Some people do not like to deposit their money in banks.
ex.zh: 有些人不喜歡把錢存銀行。

ex.en: What percentage of all taxi drivers make unscrupulous detours, do you think?
ex.zh: 你覺得有多少比例的計程車司機會故意繞遠路？

ex.en: We took a detour because the bridge was closed.
ex.zh: 因為橋封閉了，我們繞道而行。

ex.en: Do you have anything to declare?
ex.zh: 您有任何東西要申報嗎？

ex.en: You must declare any goods over the duty-free limit.
ex.zh: 超過免稅額度的物品必須申報。

ex.en: The US declared independence from Great Britain in 1776.
ex.zh: 美國在 1776 年宣布脫離英國獨立。

ex.en: The country declared war against its neighbor.
ex.zh: 那個國家向鄰國宣戰了。

ex.en: Please fill out the customs declaration form.
ex.zh: 請填寫海關申報單。

ex.en: Your declaration must list all items you bought abroad.
ex.zh: 你的申報必須列出所有在國外購買的物品。

ex.en: The Declaration of Independence was signed in 1776.
ex.zh: 《獨立宣言》在 1776 年簽署。

ex.en: She made a public declaration of her support.
ex.zh: 她公開聲明支持。

ex.en: He was deported for working without a visa.
ex.zh: 他因為沒有簽證就工作而被驅逐出境。

ex.en: The government plans to deport illegal workers.
ex.zh: 政府計畫將非法勞工驅逐出境。
